Density-derived quasi-potential landscape. The Synthetic developmental state series experiment
uses molecular layers layer1, layer2. The black curve shows U(x) = -log p(x), derived from the
stored density estimate for component 1; Rug marks show observed sample coordinates; rug
colours encode categorical planted_group; Exploratory downward triangles mark stored wells;
Exploratory upward triangles mark stored barriers; Dotted vertical segments show point-estimate
barrier heights. The analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design is
cross_sectional; the estimand is the density-derived quasi-potential along the selected
component. Critical-point classifications and barrier heights are point estimates without
uncertainty. No calibrated critical-point or barrier threshold is applied. The landscape is an
exploratory description and does not by itself establish a biological state transition.
